proof_review.note: Full article retained as conservative closed context for notation, global assumptions, diagrams and references. Exact primary and supporting physical proof pages are recorded separately. Proposition3.1: I=[0,1] or S1, f:I to I of class C^r for real r>1, R(f)=lim n^-1 logplus norm((f^n)prime), and b>R(f)/r. There exist p0 and beta>0 such that every p>=p0 has epsilon_p>0, and every epsilon_p-bounded injective reparametrization sigma has exponentially small Lebesgue set of points x in sigma-image with |(f^n)prime(x)|>=exp(nb) and geometric-time density d_floor(n/p)(E_p(x))<beta. The limsup of n^-1 log of that measure is strictly negative. Geometric times are exactly the selected expansion vertices of the authored tree2.4/Section3, not arbitrary hyperbolic-time choices. Full derivative-sum, branch-count/change-of-variable and arbitrary-remainder-time proof13–14 read; new tree construction/count7–12 read. Burguet reference5 reparametrization subdivision Lemma6 and its bounded-derivative local construction are explicitly traced existing research foundations, with authors additional circle injectivity split11 included. No SRB/acim existence, basin covering, finiteness or entropy-formula outcome counted; subsequent empirical/entropy/SRB cores remain uncertified. Whole45-page original retained, actual JEP13(2026) DOI10.5802/jep.351 and individual CC BY4 license.
